places.quote: In London itself, though in the old rustic road
places.note: Setting of the chapter; named once, in the opening sentence.

places.normalized: Bleeding Heart Yard, Hatton Garden, London
places.quote: Bleeding Heart Yard was to be found; a place much changed in feature and in fortune
places.note: Fictional yard, modelled on a real court in Holborn/Hatton Garden area; the modern location is approximate.

places.quote: There's a gentleman to have run to seed in the Marshalsea jail!
I have been on the wrong side of the Lock myself
places.note: Ambiguous reference to a debtors' lock-up; location uncertain, possibly Southwark.

places.quote: as willing a Yard as any in Britain
as Arabs of the desert pitch their tents among the fallen stones of the Pyramids
